ctx.x: John Cotter made the arrangements for us, and Jimmy Forrest and Lucille Agers really broke it up. On that particular trip. But '46 we came back to St. Louis. The music started going, the big bands started getting farther away. Started getting rough. We would get a few gigs here and there, a few gigs here and there.

Then we started working in '47. We would work in the Tunetown Ballroom maybe two or three times a week. And the last date we had at the Tunetown Ballroom was the last night the Tunetown Ballroom was open. The Internal Revenue men came in, and closed the Tunetown Ballroom down.
